title: data-gravity-operator: Data-Locality-Aware Workload Scheduling for Kubernetes on WLCG Data Lakes
description:
A Kubernetes operator that injects topology-aware NodeAffinity constraints into compute Jobs based on Rucio dataset replica locations, enabling data-local compute scheduling on WLCG-style data lakes.

The operator introduces a PhysicsJob custom resource. Submitting a PhysicsJob with a Rucio DID (scope:name) causes the operator to (1) resolve the dataset's primary Rucio Storage Element, (2) map that RSE to a Kubernetes node via the topology.cern.io/site label, and (3) create an owned batch/v1.Job with a NodeAffinity requirement matching that site label. Compute therefore runs co-located with the data, eliminating the inter-site WAN transfer that would otherwise be incurred by the default kube-scheduler.

Implemented in Go using the kubebuilder/controller-runtime framework. Includes a mock Rucio replica server with seed data covering ATLAS, CMS, and LHCb dataset classes, an end-to-end demo against a 4-node kind cluster, a Helm chart, and Prometheus instrumentation for reconcile lifecycle, RSE resolution, and bytes-of-WAN-transfer-avoided.
